name: aged-lock-packs-collected-old-packs
note: AgedLockPacksCollected with packs older than T_pack (phase F part 7, built from aged-lock-packs-collected for 04 step 5): a 6 h 1 min jump between the backup's uploads and its commit lock, a 3 h 1 min jump before its fence (which refreshes the lock), and a 6 h 1 min jump after it; compact then reaps the aged lock and marker and deletes the backup's packs, 15 h old orphans on the store's clock, and the backup's head names them. Since 04 step 5 orphans younger than T_pack are kept, so the packs must be this old. Fixed by 04 step 8. Since phase F part 8c (04 step 7, young segments) the backup's later fold keeps its first segment (about 6 h old at the fold, younger than T_pack) named after the new base instead of carrying its entries into the base; compact's index GC collected that segment, so the head names an absent segment and the chain does not load: AgedLockSegmentCollected claims the case, and the IndexNamesAbsentPack that AgedLockPacksCollected claimed is no longer reached (the collected segment is missing from the fold's listing of index.d/, and a segment the listing lacks reads young, so no number of further jumps lets a fold carry its entries into a base; before 8c the fold took them from the backup's local cache and hid the loss behind the absent packs). The scripted test an_aged_lock_head_names_packs_compact_deleted (tests/sim.rs) shows AgedLockPacksCollected with the compact's index GC deletes failing. Fixed by 04 step 8. Since 04 step 8 (phase F part 9) this runs on the fallback store, which keeps the hazard; aged-lock-packs-collected-old-packs-conditional is the same case on a conditional store.
